name: File Action Initiation V 04
definition: The FileActionInitiation message can be initiated by any party and received by any party (acquirer, agent or issuer).||This message is used to inquire, add, change, delete or replace a file or a record.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management.

MessageReason.name: Message Reason
MessageReason.definition: Reason or purpose to send the message.||The ISO 8583 maintenance agency (MA) manages this code list.

AlternateMessageReason.name: Alternate Message Reason
AlternateMessageReason.definition: Supports message reason codes that are not defined in external code list.

FileActionType.name: File Action Type
FileActionType.definition: Type of file action. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

TransactionDescription.name: Transaction Description
TransactionDescription.definition: Transaction data related to programmes and services, content and format based on bilateral agreements.

Continuation.name: Continuation
Continuation.definition: Indicates that batch or collection is not complete.

Originator.name: Originator
Originator.definition: Identifies the originator of the transaction.

Sender.name: Sender
Sender.definition: Party sending the message to another intermediary agent or to the final destination.

Card.name: Card
Card.definition: Card or payment token performing the transaction.

Receiver.name: Receiver
Receiver.definition: Party receiving the message from the origin or from an intermediary agent.

Destination.name: Destination
Destination.definition: Identifies the destination of the transaction.

Programme.name: Programme
Programme.definition: Programme, network, or brand processes the transaction.

SystemTraceAuditNumber.name: System Trace Audit Number
SystemTraceAuditNumber.definition: Number assigned by a transaction originator to assist in identifying a transaction uniquely. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages within a two-message exchange (for example, request/repeat and response)

TransmissionDateTime.name: Transmission Date Time
TransmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time expressed in UTC of the message as sent by the initiator.

RetrievalReferenceNumber.name: Retrieval Reference Number
RetrievalReferenceNumber.definition: A reference supplied by the system retaining the original source information and used to assist in locating that information or a copy thereof.

Format.name: Format
Format.definition: File format code. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

DataRecord.name: Data Record
DataRecord.definition: Content of record to be added, updated, deleted or replaced.

ActionDate.name: Action Date
ActionDate.definition: Date when the file action should be performed.

FileSecurityCode.name: File Security Code
FileSecurityCode.definition: Indicates that the originator of the message is authorised to update the file.

Correction.name: Correction
Correction.definition: Identifies that this batch or collection is a corrected version of a batch or collection that was previously sent.

Acceptor.name: Acceptor
Acceptor.definition: Card acceptor performing the card transaction.

Terminal.name: Terminal
Terminal.definition: Payment terminal or ATM performing the transaction.

POIComponent.name: POI Component
POIComponent.definition: Data related to the components of the POI (Point Of Interaction) performing the transactions.

Payer.name: Payer
Payer.definition: The party providing source of funds.

CustomerDevice.name: Customer Device
CustomerDevice.definition: Identification of the customer device performing the transaction.

Wallet.name: Wallet
Wallet.definition: Container for tenders used by the customer to perform the payment transaction.

Cardholder.name: Cardholder
Cardholder.definition: Cardholder performing the card payment transaction.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Contains information that identifies or is specific to a transaction jurisdiction.

SettlementService.name: Settlement Service
SettlementService.definition: Type of settlement service for specific services requiring settlement.

AdditionalFee.name: Additional Fee
AdditionalFee.definition: Fees not included in the transaction amount.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period between the acquirer and the issuer or their respective agents.

ProtectedData.name: Protected Data
ProtectedData.definition: Contains protected data and the attributes used to protect the data.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC
